issue_context.title: QueryMsgByUniqueKey tool should return all messages with same unique key
issue_context.body:
The same message may be delivered to the server twice or more.
Their unique keys are the same because client may resend them. 
When we use the queryMsgByUniqueKey tool, only one message is filter and returned. It should return all messages with same unique key.
